title: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on how to enrich students' knowledge of traditional Chinese culture. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Traditional Chinese culture is a treasure that shapes our national identity, yet many students today know little about it. As a contributor to our university newspaper, I would like to share several practical ways to enrich students' understanding of this precious heritage. To begin with, our university could offer optional courses and regular lectures on classical literature, calligraphy and traditional festivals, so as to build a solid foundation of knowledge. In addition, hands-on activities are equally important. By organizing cultural experiences such as paper-cutting workshops or tea ceremonies, students can feel the charm of tradition rather than merely reading about it. Moreover, we can make full use of new media, posting short videos and articles online to spread cultural knowledge in a way that appeals to young people. In conclusion, combining formal learning, personal experience and modern technology would help students appreciate traditional Chinese culture far more deeply. I sincerely hope these suggestions will benefit us all.
keyPoints: 两句扣题亮中心。落实『扣征稿点主题』：首句用『___ is a treasure ... yet ...』点出意义， 第二句以投稿人身份『As a contributor to our university newspaper, I would like to share several practical ways』亮出中心，两句内就回扣 how to enrich students' knowledge of traditional Chinese culture，不绕圈。

三办法各带理由。落实『一条办法一句理由』：To begin with 领起选修课并用『so as to build a solid foundation』给理由；In addition 领起体验活动并用『students can feel the charm of tradition rather than merely reading about it』说明好处；Moreover 领起新媒体。三条办法都具体到 剪纸、茶艺、短视频，避免空喊。
归总呼应结尾。落实『归总加呼吁』：In conclusion 把 formal learning, personal experience and modern technology 三条收成一句，重申价值，末句『I sincerely hope these suggestions will benefit us all』面向读者呼吁，首尾呼应、结构完整。
